title: Merging rigor and relevance in grazingland research: A comprehensive social-ecological monitoring approach
The two-edged sword of altruism in willingness to pay for water infrastructure and affordability programs
abstract: Aging water and sewer infrastructure in the United States poses significant health and environmental risks. While higher water and sewer rates can finance infrastructure replacement, they may also exacerbate affordability challenges for low-income households. This study employs a choice experiment to estimate public valuation of infrastructure replacement programs and statewide water affordability programs that ensure water and sewer access for low-income households. The study also explores if altruistic preferences and perceptions about beneficiaries’ water use influence program support and develops a novel measure of altruism suitable for online surveys. Analysis of survey responses from 1,732 Michigan and Ohio residents reveals strong public support for infrastructure replacement programs that improve health and environmental outcomes. Altruists have a higher willingness to pay (WTP) than non-altruists for both infrastructure replacement and affordability programs. Paternalistic altruists, that is, altruists who care about consumption of specific goods such as water and sewer, have higher marginal WTP for addressing deteriorating health effects from aging infrastructure. While altruists show higher WTP for affordability programs compared to non-altruists, their WTP can be lower if altruists have concerns that beneficiaries of a water affordability program will waste water. Policy implications include making the impact of aging infrastructure tangible, addressing wastefulness concerns, and incentive-based affordability programs for viable water and sewer programs.
abstract_zh: 美国老化的供水和污水基础设施对健康和环境构成重大风险。尽管提高水费和污水费可以为基础设施更换提供资金，但这也可能加剧低收入家庭的承受能力挑战。本研究采用选择实验，估算公众对基础设施更换项目以及确保低收入家庭获得供水和污水服务的全州性水资源可负担性项目的支持程度。研究还探讨了利他偏好以及对受益人用水的认知是否影响项目支持度，并开发了一种适用于在线调查的新型利他主义测度。对来自密歇根州和俄亥俄州1,732名居民的调查结果分析显示，公众强烈支持能够改善健康和环境结果的基础设施更换项目。在基础设施更换项目和可负担性项目两方面，利他主义者的支付意愿（WTP）均高于非利他主义者。家长式利他主义者，即关心特定商品（如水和污水服务）消费的利他主义者，对于解决老化基础设施导致的健康恶化问题，具有更高的边际支付意愿。虽然与非利他主义者相比，利他主义者对可负担性项目表现出更高的支付意愿，但如果他们担心可负担性项目的受益者会浪费用水，其支付意愿可能会降低。政策含义包括：让老化基础设施的影响变得切实可见，回应对浪费的担忧，以及为可行的供水和污水项目设计基于激励的可负担性方案。

title: Benefits, costs, and affordability of frequent PFAS testing in public water systems
abstract: Drinking water is a principal pathway for human exposure to per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), yet inconsistent PFAS testing limits effective mitigation strategies. This study estimates households’ WTP for monthly PFAS testing policy across Michigan and Ohio public water systems and compares benefits with costs. Estimated WTP is $267 per household annually. Testing costs vary by utility size and water source, but mean WTP exceeds average costs across all utilities. Fewer than 1% of survey households exceed affordability concerns from added policy costs. The findings can inform policy discussions on PFAS monitoring as the NPDWR PFAS rule is under reconsideration.
abstract_zh: 饮用水是人类接触全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS）的主要途径，然而，不一致的PFAS检测限制了有效的缓解策略。本研究估算了密歇根州和俄亥俄州公共供水系统中，家庭对每月进行PFAS检测政策的支付意愿，并将效益与成本进行了比较。估算的支付意愿为每户每年267美元。检测成本因公用事业规模和水源而异，但在所有公用事业机构中，平均支付意愿均超过平均成本。调查家庭中不到1%的家庭因政策新增成本而面临承受能力方面的担忧。这些发现可为关于PFAS监测的政策讨论提供参考，因为美国国家饮用水一级标准（NPDWR）的PFAS规则目前正在重新审议之中。

How sustainability certification works for smallholder farmers across different crops
abstract: Sustainability certification (SC) aims to address negative impacts associated with production, processing, and trade of commodity crops. The efficacy of SC for smallholder producers depends on households adopting and aligning their own production practices with stipulated standards and practices. Using data from 357 households in Ghana, we examine smallholders’ experiences with Fairtrade certification across four different crops: cocoa, pineapples, oranges, and cashews. We find significant gaps in certification implementation including inadequate training, infrequent inspections, and lack of knowledge about price premiums. The results suggest the need for implementation strategies that reflects smallholders’ context-specific issues and foster greater training and inspection.
abstract_zh: 可持续认证（SC）旨在解决与大宗作物的生产、加工和贸易相关的负面影响。对于小农生产者而言，可持续认证的成效取决于农户是否采纳并使自身的生产实践与规定的标准和做法相一致。利用来自加纳357户家庭的数据，我们考察了小农在四种不同作物（可可、菠萝、橙子和腰果）上使用公平贸易（Fairtrade）认证的经验。我们发现，认证的实施存在显著缺口，包括培训不足、检查不频繁，以及对价格溢价缺乏了解。结果表明，需要制定能够反映小农具体情境问题的实施策略，并加强培训和检查。

title: Phosphorus application rates and farmers' perceptions of environmental concerns
abstract:
Fertilizer overapplication remains a persistent challenge in several US watersheds. Farmer attitudes play a key role in nutrient management decisions, but few studies link farmer attitudes to phosphorus(P) fertilizer application rates. This study analyzes survey responses from 1650 Michigan corn farmers to assess P application behaviors and attitudes. The objective is to identify factors influencing P management and evaluate differences between P‐overapplying and non‐overapplying farmers. Overapplication is based on self‐reported P use and soil P levels, and differences are tested using chi‐square tests. Results show significant differences in attitudes, perceptions, and management practices between the two groups. Overapplying farmers express greater concern about nutrient runoff, suggesting they may be receptive to interventions. This study emphasizes the need to address P overapplication and improve information dissemination through agricultural consultants, soil testing laboratories, and extension services, as 55% of farmers reported not receiving recent information on P yield response.
Farmer attitudes and perceptions are critical factors influencing management practice adoption.
Self‐reported survey data for 1650 corn farmers in Michigan reveal phosphorus (P) fertilizer overapplication.
Farmers that overapply P fertilizer have different attitudes than other farmers.
Farmers overapplying P fertilizer indicate higher environmental concerns.
abstract_zh:
化肥过量施用仍是美国若干流域长期面临的挑战。农民的态度在养分管理决策中发挥着关键作用，但很少有研究将农民态度与磷肥施用量联系起来。本研究分析了来自密歇根州1650名玉米种植农民的调查问卷，以评估其磷肥施用行为和态度。研究目标是识别影响磷管理的因素，并评估过量施磷农民与未过量施磷农民之间的差异。过量施用的判定依据是农民自报的磷肥用量以及土壤磷水平，两组之间的差异采用卡方检验进行检验。结果显示，两组在态度、认知和管理实践方面存在显著差异。过量施磷的农民对养分径流表现出更大的担忧，这表明他们可能愿意接受干预。本研究强调，需要解决磷的过量施用问题，并通过农业顾问、土壤检测实验室和推广服务改善信息传播，因为55%的农民表示未曾收到近期关于磷肥产量反应的信息。
农民的态度和认知是影响管理实践采纳的关键因素。
基于1650名密歇根玉米种植者的自报调查数据显示，存在磷肥过量施用的现象。
过量施用磷肥的农民，其态度与其他农民不同。
过量施用磷肥的农民表现出更高的环境担忧。

title: Evaluating the impact of fertilizer and crop prices on phosphorus concentrations in Great Lakes watersheds
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: Crop and input prices affect agricultural production and water pollution. Fertilizer prices fluctuated over the past two decades, recently increasing substantially. Corn prices also increased after authorization of the Renewable Fuel Standard. This paper estimates the effect of fertilizer and corn prices on total phosphorus (TP) and dissolved phosphorus (DP) concentrations across 226 Great Lakes region watersheds. Findings indicate that a 10% rise in fertilizer prices reduces TP by 3% and DP by 6.9%. Counterfactual analysis shows that without recent fertilizer price hikes, nutrient concentrations would be higher, underscoring the impact of crop and input prices on phosphorus pollution.
abstract_zh: 作物和投入品价格影响农业生产和水污染。过去二十年间化肥价格波动，近期大幅上涨。在《可再生燃料标准》获批实施后，玉米价格也随之上升。本文估算了化肥价格和玉米价格对五大湖地区226个流域总磷（TP）和溶解态磷（DP）浓度的影响。结果表明，化肥价格每上涨10%，总磷降低3%，溶解态磷降低6.9%。反事实分析显示，若没有近期的化肥价格上涨，养分浓度将会更高，这突显了作物和投入品价格对磷污染的影响。

title: Comparing water quality valuation across probability and non-probability samples
Getting off the ladder: Disentangling water quality indices to enhance the valuation of divergent ecosystem services
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Many water quality valuation studies and Federal cost–benefit analyses build from pioneering work using a “water quality ladder” or a single water quality index (WQI) to characterize both current conditions and effects of policies. When policies lead to contrasting changes in valued ecosystem services like recreational fishing and swimming, analyses using a single ladder or index might obscure important underlying service trade-offs. We test for this effect using alternative approaches that separate water quality indices and value changes in distinct ecosystem services stemming from policies with small to moderate changes in water quality. The indices we test relate to nutrient loadings in Michigan’s rivers, lakes, and Great Lakes. Our split-sample experiment compares economic values for treatments with two versus three quality metrics. The key distinction is that the two-index survey, like many existing studies, aggregates subindices for water contact (for swimming and boating) and fish biomass scores (for fishing) into a single WQI, whereas the three-index survey separately utilizes both. We find that changes in our index reflecting changes in fecal bacteria and water clarity are valued differently from changes in our recreational fishing index. Aggregating changes in these two distinct recreational services using a single WQI yields consistently lower benefit estimates across a range of underlying changes in our experiment. In valuation scenarios with small changes in overall water quality, the WQI-based benefit estimates can differ substantially from benefits measured by decomposing the index and valuing the disparate subindices, differences which might change balance of benefits and costs in regulatory evaluations.
abstract_zh: 许多水质价值评估研究和联邦成本效益分析，都是以“水质阶梯”或单一水质指数（WQI）为基础，来刻画当前状况以及政策效应的，这一做法源于开创性的工作。当政策导致娱乐性捕鱼和游泳等受重视的生态系统服务发生相反方向的变化时，使用单一阶梯或指数的分析可能掩盖重要的潜在服务权衡。我们采用替代方法检验这一效应，这些方法将水质指数分开，并对由中小幅度水质变化的政策所引起的不同生态系统服务变化分别进行估值。我们检验的指数涉及密歇根州河流、湖泊和五大湖的养分负荷。我们的分样本实验比较了两种质量指标与三种质量指标处理下的经济价值。关键区别在于：两指数调查与许多现有研究一样，将水体接触（游泳和划船）的子指数与鱼类生物量得分（用于捕鱼）汇总为单一WQI，而三指数调查则分别使用这两者。我们发现，反映大肠杆菌和水体透明度变化的指数，其价值与娱乐性捕鱼指数变化的价值不同。在本实验的一系列潜在变化中，使用单一WQI汇总这两种不同的娱乐服务，得出的效益估计值始终偏低。在整体水质变化较小的估值情景中，基于WQI的效益估计值可能与通过分解指数并分别对各子指数估值所得的效益显著不同，而这些差异可能会改变监管评估中效益与成本的平衡。

title: Measuring beachgoer preferences for avoiding harmful algal blooms and bacterial warnings
Testing the robustness of a structural model for discerning use and non-use values of ecosystem services
abstract: A theoretically consistent structural model facilitates definition and measurement of use and non-use benefits of ecosystem services. Unlike many previous approaches that utilize multiple stated choice situations, we apply this conceptual framework to a travel cost random utility model and a consequential single referendum contingent valuation research design for simultaneously estimating use and non-use willingness to pay for environmental quality improvement. We employ Monte Carlo generated data to evaluate properties of key parameters and examine the robustness of this method of measuring use and non-use values associated with quality change. The simulation study confirms that this new method, combined with simulated revealed and stated preference data can generally, but not always, be applied to successfully identify use and non-use values of various ecosystems while consistency is ensured.
abstract_zh: 一个理论上一致的结构模型有助于界定和衡量生态系统服务的使用效益与非使用效益。与以往许多使用多个陈述选择情境的方法不同，我们将这一概念框架应用于旅行成本随机效用模型，以及具有现实约束力的单次公投条件价值评估研究设计，从而同时估计环境质量改善的使用与非使用支付意愿。我们采用蒙特卡洛模拟生成的数据来评估关键参数的性质，并检验这一测度使用与非使用价值的方法在质量变化情形下的稳健性。模拟研究证实，这种新方法结合模拟的显示偏好和陈述偏好数据，通常（但并非总是）能够成功识别各类生态系统的使用与非使用价值，同时保证一致性。

title: Distributional effects of entry fees and taxation for financing public beaches
Estimating visitor preferences for recreation sites in wildfire prone areas
abstract: Development into the wildland–urban interface, combined with heat and drought, contribute to increasing wildfires in the U.S. West and a range of damages including recreation site closures and longer-term effects on recreation areas. A choice experiment survey is used to estimate visitor preferences for vegetation and the effects of past fire at recreation sites. Intercept interviews are used to randomly select visitors at national forest sites near Los Angeles. The choice model results reveal that recreation sites with waterbodies and sites with tree cover, instead of shrubs or barren areas, are highly desirable, while evidence of past fires decreases the value of a site. We find the effects of past fire depend on vegetation type, fire intensity and time since the fire ended. Older forest fires and shrub fires are undesirable, but forest fires that reach the crowns of trees are least desirable. The findings add to evidence that fire damage to recreation areas extends beyond closures and depends on vegetation, which can inform the allocation of firefighting and prevention resources.
abstract_zh: 随着城市边缘带（wildland–urban interface）的开发，加之高温和干旱，美国西部野火日益增多，造成的损害包括休闲场地关闭，以及休闲区域的长期影响。本研究采用选择实验调查，估算游客对植被以及既往火灾对休闲场地影响的偏好。研究通过拦截访谈，在洛杉矶附近的国家森林场地随机选取游客。选择模型结果显示，拥有水体的休闲场地和有树木覆盖的场地（相对于灌木或裸地）具有很高的吸引力，而既往火灾的痕迹则降低了场地的价值。我们发现，既往火灾的影响取决于植被类型、火灾强度以及火灾结束后的时间。较早的森林火灾和灌丛火灾均不受欢迎，而烧至树冠的森林火灾最不受欢迎。研究结果进一步证明，火灾对休闲区域的损害不仅限于场地关闭，还取决于植被类型，这可为消防和预防资源的配置提供参考。

title: How does congestion affect the evaluation of recreational gate fees? An application to Gulf Coast Beaches
abstract: We investigate how congestion influences the welfare, revenue-raising, and distributional implications of gate fees at outdoor recreational sites. A simple conceptual framework decomposes the effects of gate fees into three components, which are then quantified in an application to Gulf Coast beaches. Simulation results suggest that when congestion is a disamenity, the deadweight loss from gate fees declines, the revenue raised grows, and leakage to untaxed sites is less. Congestion feedbacks do not substantively change our distributional analysis, which implies that gate fees are regressive, do not disproportionately affect minorities, and privilege local recreators at the expense of overnight visitors.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了拥挤如何影响户外休闲场所门票（gate fees）的福利、财政收入和分配效应。一个简单的概念框架将门票的效应分解为三个组成部分，随后我们将其应用于墨西哥湾沿岸海滩进行量化。模拟结果表明，当拥挤是一种负效用时，门票带来的无谓损失会下降，财政收入会增加，而流向未征税场所的转移也会减少。拥挤反馈并不会实质性地改变我们的分配分析结果，这意味着门票具有累退性，不会对少数族裔产生不成比例的影响，并且有利于本地休闲者，而牺牲了过夜游客的利益。

How will climate change affect provision and value of water from public lands in Southern California through the 21st century?
Linking agricultural nutrient pollution to the value of freshwater ecosystem services
abstract: This paper describes our efforts to integrate economic and biophysical models to evaluate the effects agri-environmental policies have on the value of freshwater ecosystem services. We are developing an integrated assessment model (IAM) that links changes in phosphorus-related management practices on farm fields to changes in the value of key freshwater ecosystem services, including biological condition, water clarity, species-specific fish biomasses, and beach algae. Our IAM approach enables examination of the effects of policies and conservation programs on ecosystem services and values. Results will help policy makers allocate conservation dollars to improve water quality, enhance ecosystem services, and promote more sustainable agricultural production. (JEL Q24, Q51)
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了我们将经济模型与生物物理模型相整合的努力，以评估农业环境政策对淡水生态系统服务价值的影响。我们正在开发一个综合评估模型（IAM），该模型将农田中与磷相关的管理措施变化，与关键淡水生态系统服务价值的变化联系起来，这些服务包括生物状况、水体透明度、特定物种的鱼类生物量以及海滩藻类。我们的IAM方法能够考察政策和保护计划对生态系统服务及其价值的影响。研究结果将有助于决策者分配保护资金，以改善水质、增强生态系统服务，并促进更可持续的农业生产。（JEL Q24, Q51）

Valuing provision scenarios of coastal ecosystem services: The case of boat ramp closings due to algae blooms in Florida
abstract: Ecosystem service flows may change or disappear temporarily or permanently as a result of environmental changes or ecological disturbances. In coastal areas, ecological disturbances caused by toxin-producing harmful algae blooms can impact flows of ecosystem services, particularly provisioning (e.g., seafood harvesting) and cultural services (e.g., recreation). This study uses a random utility model of recreational boating choices to simulate changes in the value of cultural ecosystem services provided by recreation in coastal ecosystems resulting from prolonged ecological disturbances caused by harmful algae blooms. The empirical application relies on observed trips to 35 alternative boat access ramps in Lee County, an important marine access destination in southwest Florida. Results indicate that reduced boating access from harmful algae blooms may have resulted in losses of $3 million for the 2018 blooms, which lasted from the end of June to the end of September.
abstract_zh: 由于环境变化或生态扰动，生态系统服务流量可能会暂时或永久地改变或消失。在沿海地区，产毒有害藻华所造成的生态扰动，可能影响服务流量，尤其是供给服务（如海产品捕捞）和文化服务（如休闲娱乐）。本研究使用休闲船只选择的随机效用模型，模拟由有害藻华长期生态扰动导致的沿海生态系统休闲服务文化价值的变化。实证应用依托于佛罗里达州西南部重要的海上通道目的地李县（Lee County）内35个可选船只下水坡道的实际游览记录。结果表明，2018年有害藻华导致的船只通行受限，可能造成了300万美元的损失，该藻华从6月底持续至9月底。

title: Feedback of telecoupling: The case of a payment for ecosystem services program
Lakefront property owners' willingness to accept easements for conservation of water quality and habitat
abstract: Lakes provide valuable ecosystem services such as food, drinking water, and recreation, but shoreline development can degrade riparian habitats and lake ecosystems. Easement contracts for specific property rights can encourage conservation practices for enhanced water quality, fish habitat, and wildlife habitat, yet little is known about the easement market. We surveyed inland lake shoreline property owners in Michigan to assess supply of two conservation easements (in riparian and in littoral zones) and identified property and property owner characteristics influencing potential enrollment. Respondents were significantly less likely to enroll in littoral easements if they indicated there was social pressure for manicured lawns and more likely to enroll if they had more formal education, shoreline frontage, naturally occurring riparian plants, ecological knowledge, or if the lake shoreline was more developed. Enrollment in easements in the riparian zone was significantly less likely if property owners indicated social pressure for manicured lawns, but more likely if they had more formal education, naturally occurring riparian plants, or shoreline frontage. When payments were low (−1), marginal gains in enrollment were relatively high. Some respondents may enroll in littoral (29.8% ± 2.2; mean ± SE) and riparian (24.4% ± 2.1) easements even without payment. Estimated mean willingness to accept values were $1,365 yr−1 (littoral) and $7,298 yr−1 (riparian). Targeting high‐probability property owners with large shoreline frontages, more formal education, and high riparian plant coverages and conducting education to increase ecological knowledge and change social norms could increase conservation outcomes for water quality and habitat.
abstract_zh: 湖滨地产业主接受水质保护地役权的意愿。湖泊提供食物、饮用水和休闲娱乐等有价值的生态系统服务，但岸线开发可能破坏河岸栖息地和湖泊生态系统。针对特定产权的地役权合同可以促进有利于提升水质、鱼类栖息地和野生动物栖息地的保护行为，但人们对地役权市场知之甚少。我们对密歇根州内陆湖泊岸线的地产业主进行了调查，以评估两种保护性地役权（河岸带和沿岸带）的供给情况，并识别影响潜在参与意愿的地产及业主特征。若受访者表示存在修剪整齐草坪的社会压力，其参与沿岸带地役权的可能性显著降低；若其受教育程度更高、岸线临湖长度更长、自然生长有河岸植物、具备生态知识，或湖岸开发程度更高，则参与可能性显著提高。若受访者表示存在修剪整齐草坪的社会压力，其参与河岸带地役权的可能性同样显著降低；若其受教育程度更高、自然生长有河岸植物或岸线临湖长度更长，则参与可能性显著提高。当补偿较低（−1）时，参与率的边际增幅相对较高。部分受访者即使在无补偿的情况下也可能参与沿岸带（29.8% ± 2.2；均值 ± 标准误）和河岸带（24.4% ± 2.1）地役权。估计的平均受偿意愿分别为每年 1,365 美元（沿岸带）和每年 7,298 美元（河岸带）。将岸线临湖长度较长、受教育程度较高且河岸植被覆盖率高的高概率业主作为目标，并开展提升生态知识、改变社会规范的宣传教育，可以提高水质和栖息地的保护成效。

title: Accounting for ecosystem services in compensating for the costs of effective conservation in protected areas
Ecosystem services in the Great Lakes
Quantifying changes in water use and groundwater availability in a megacity using novel integrated systems modeling
abstract: Water sustainability in megacities is a growing challenge with far‐reaching effects. Addressing sustainability requires an integrated, multidisciplinary approach able to capture interactions among hydrology, population growth, and socioeconomic factors and to reflect changes due to climate variability and land use. We developed a new systems modeling framework to quantify the influence of changes in land use, crop growth, and urbanization on groundwater storage for Beijing, China. This framework was then used to understand and quantify causes of observed decreases in groundwater storage from 1993 to 2006, revealing that the expansion of Beijing's urban areas at the expense of croplands has enhanced recharge while reducing water lost to evapotranspiration, partially ameliorating groundwater declines. The results demonstrate the efficacy of such a systems approach to quantify the impacts of changes in climate and land use on water sustainability for megacities, while providing a quantitative framework to improve mitigation and adaptation strategies that can help address future water challenges.
abstract_zh: 特大城市的水资源可持续性是一项日益严峻且影响深远的挑战。应对可持续性问题需要一种综合性、多学科的方法，能够刻画水文、人口增长与社会经济因素之间的相互作用，并反映气候变率和土地利用变化带来的影响。我们开发了一种新的系统建模框架，用于量化土地利用、作物生长和城市化变化对中国北京地下水储量的影响。随后，我们运用该框架理解并量化1993年至2006年间观测到的地下水储量下降的原因，结果表明：北京城市建成区以耕地为代价的扩张，增强了地下水补给，同时减少了蒸散发造成的水分损失，从而部分缓解了地下水位的下降。研究结果表明，这种系统性方法能够有效量化气候与土地利用变化对特大城市水资源可持续性的影响，并为改进减缓和适应策略提供定量框架，以应对未来的水资源挑战。

title: Demand for Fishery Regulations: Effects of Angler Heterogeneity and Catch Improvements on Preferences for Gear and Harvest Restrictions
Evolution of tourism in a flagship protected area of China

Sociocultural and institutional contexts of social cash transfer programs
Solving the phosphorus pollution puzzle: Synthesis and directions for future research
abstract: Despite the success of efforts to reduce phosphorus (P) pollution from point sources, P from non‐point agricultural sources remains a vexing problem with many U.S. water bodies having impairments. Key to solving the P pollution puzzle is to take stock of progress to date, the puzzle pieces available, and the gaps to be filled. In this paper, we synthesize the state of knowledge on P pollution, discuss the state of existing public programs, and review economists' contributions to informing P pollution policies. We review the water quality valuation literature, identifying limitations in the linkages to policy‐relevant environmental quality metrics. We examine how and why P is used agriculturally, along with recent advances in market‐based policy design and field testing. We survey new knowledge in biology and engineering, including improved understanding of the fate and transport of P. In light of recent learning and persistent knowledge gaps, we recommend directions for economic research to add needed pieces to the puzzle of how to protect our water bodies. Puzzle gaps meriting attention include mechanisms to target public funds more effectively in voluntary abatement programs, policy design for emerging mitigation technologies, new ways to implement performance‐based policies, means to leverage social norms and behavioral cues, changes in the “pay‐the‐polluter” paradigm, and application of state‐of‐the‐art evaluation methods to conservation programs. Beyond the realm of public policy lies that of private supply chains, where establishment of environmental standards holds additional promise. Rich research opportunities exist for economists in tandem with biologists, engineers, and others.
abstract_zh: 破解磷污染难题：研究综述与未来方向。尽管点源磷污染的治理已取得成效，但来自农业面源的磷污染依然是一个棘手的问题，许多美国水体因此受损。破解磷污染难题的关键，在于厘清迄今的进展、可用的拼图碎片以及尚待填补的空白。本文综合了关于磷污染的研究现状，讨论了现有公共计划的状况，并回顾了经济学家在为磷污染政策提供信息方面的贡献。我们梳理了水质价值评估文献，指出其与政策相关的环境质量指标之间联系的局限性。我们考察了农业中磷的使用方式与原因，以及基于市场的政策设计和田间试验的最新进展。我们还综述了生物学和工程学的新知识，包括对磷的迁移转化过程的更深入理解。鉴于近期的学习进展和持续存在的知识空白，我们提出了经济学研究的方向，以补充保护水体的拼图。值得关注的研究空白包括：在自愿减排计划中更有效地定向使用公共资金的机制，针对新兴减排技术的政策设计，实施绩效导向型政策的新方法，利用社会规范与行为线索的途径，“付费给污染者”范式的转变，以及将前沿评估方法应用于保护计划。在公共政策之外，私人供应链也是一个重要领域，建立环境标准在此具有额外的前景。经济学家与生物学家、工程师及其他学科学者携手，将拥有丰富的研究机遇。

Landscape prediction and mapping of game fish biomass, an ecosystem service of Michigan rivers
venue: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
abstract:
The increased integration of ecosystem service concepts into natural resource management places renewed emphasis on prediction and mapping of fish biomass as a major provisioning service of rivers. The goals of this study were to predict and map patterns of fish biomass as a proxy for the availability of catchable fish for anglers in rivers and to identify the strongest landscape constraints on fish productivity. We examined hypotheses about fish responses to total phosphorus (TP), as TP is a growth-limiting nutrient known to cause increases (subsidy response) and/or decreases (stress response) in fish biomass depending on its concentration and the species being considered. Boosted regression trees were used to define nonlinear functions that predicted the standing crops of Brook Trout Salvelinus fontinalis, Brown Trout Salmo trutta, Smallmouth Bass Micropterus dolomieu, panfishes (seven centrarchid species), and Walleye Sander vitreus by using landscape and modeled local-scale predictors. Fitted models were highly significant and explained 22–56% of the variation in validation data sets. Nonlinear and threshold responses were apparent for numerous predictors, including TP concentration, which had significant effects on all except the Walleye fishery. Brook Trout and Smallmouth Bass exhibited both subsidy and stress responses, panfish biomass exhibited a subsidy response only, and Brown Trout exhibited a stress response. Maps of reach-specific standing crop predictions showed patterns of predicted fish biomass that corresponded to spatial patterns in catchment area, water temperature, land cover, and nutrient availability. Maps illustrated predictions of higher trout biomass in coldwater streams draining glacial till in northern Michigan, higher Smallmouth Bass and panfish biomasses in warmwater systems of southern Michigan, and high Walleye biomass in large main-stem rivers throughout the state. Our results allow fisheries managers to examine the biomass potential of streams, describe geographic patterns of fisheries, explore possible nutrient management targets, and identify habitats that are candidates for species management.
Received May 20, 2014; accepted November 6, 2014
abstract_zh:
景观尺度下密歇根河流游钓鱼类生物量的预测与制图：一种河流生态系统服务。生态系统服务概念日益融入自然资源管理，这使得作为河流主要供给服务之一的鱼类生物量的预测与制图重新受到重视。本研究的目标是预测并绘制鱼类生物量的空间格局，以此作为河流中垂钓者可捕获鱼类数量的代理指标，并识别对鱼类生产力最强的景观约束因素。我们检验了鱼类对总磷（TP）响应的假设，因为总磷是一种限制生长的营养物质，根据其浓度和所考察物种的不同，可能导致鱼类生物量增加（补偿响应）和/或减少（胁迫响应）。我们使用提升回归树（boosted regression trees）定义非线性函数，利用景观和模型化的局部尺度预测变量，预测溪红点鲑（Brook Trout，Salvelinus fontinalis）、褐鳟（Brown Trout，Salmo trutta）、小口黑鲈（Smallmouth Bass，Micropterus dolomieu）、太阳鱼类（七种棘臀鱼科物种）以及大眼梭鲈（Walleye，Sander vitreus）的现存量。拟合模型高度显著，可解释验证数据集中 22%–56% 的变异。许多预测变量呈现非线性和阈值响应，其中总磷浓度对除大眼梭鲈渔业之外的所有鱼类都有显著影响。溪红点鲑和小口黑鲈同时表现出补偿与胁迫两种响应，太阳鱼类生物量仅表现出补偿响应，而褐鳟则表现出胁迫响应。河段特异性现存量预测图显示，鱼类生物量的预测格局与集水区面积、水温、土地覆被和营养物质可利用性的空间格局相对应。地图显示：密歇根北部冰碛土集水的冷水溪流中鳟鱼生物量较高；密歇根南部温水水系中小口黑鲈和太阳鱼类生物量较高；全州大型干流河道中大眼梭鲈生物量较高。我们的结果使渔业管理者能够评估溪流的生物量潜力，描述渔业的地理格局，探索可能的营养物管理目标，并识别适合进行物种管理的栖息地。
2014年5月20日收稿；2014年11月6日接收

title: Valuing recreational fishing quality at rivers and streams
Economic Benefits of Publicly Accessible Land for Ruffed Grouse Hunters
Estimating the Demand for Drop-Off Recycling Sites: A Random Utility Travel Cost Approach
Exploring the Middle Ground between Environmental Protection and Economic Growth
abstract: Public preference concerning the environment and the economy typically has been characterized as either pro-environmental protection or pro-economic development. Researchers and policymakers increasingly suggest that environmental protection and economic growth are not mutually exclusive. However, use of dichotomous-choice policy preference questions persists. This note empirically examines an alternative response format for the typical dichotomous-choice environmental/economic policy preference question and explores respondents’ stated policy preferences in light of their support for recycling. We find that most respondents do not view environmental protection and economic development policy goals to be mutually exclusive. Most respondents view economic growth and environmental protection as compatible suggesting a more heterogeneous view of the environment–economic relationship than oft reported. Hence excluding a middle response choice to the standard environment/economic policy preference question may add measurement error, increase item nonresponse, and fail to account for the views of respondents who view these goals as complementary.
abstract_zh: 探索环境保护与经济增长之间的中间地带。公众对环境与经济的偏好通常被刻画为要么支持环境保护，要么支持经济发展。研究者和政策制定者越来越多地提出，环境保护与经济增长并不相互排斥。然而，二分选择式的政策偏好问题仍被沿用。本研究以实证方式考察了这一典型二分选择式环境/经济政策偏好问题的另一种回答形式，并结合受访者对回收利用的支持态度，探讨其所表达的政策偏好。我们发现，大多数受访者并不认为环境保护与经济发展的政策目标是相互排斥的。大多数受访者认为经济增长与环境保护是相容的，这表明人们对环境与经济关系的看法比通常报道的更为多样。因此，在标准的环境/经济政策偏好问题中剔除中间选项，可能会增加测量误差、提高题目无应答率，并且无法反映那些将这两个目标视为互补的受访者的看法。

Linking social norms to efficient conservation investment in payments for ecosystem services
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: An increasing amount of investment has been devoted to protecting and restoring ecosystem services worldwide. The efficiency of conservation investments, including payments for ecosystem services (PES), has been found to be affected by biological, political, economic, demographic, and social factors, but little is known about the effects of social norms at the neighborhood level. As a first attempt to quantify the effects of social norms, we studied the effects of a series of possible factors on people's intentions of maintaining forest on their Grain-to-Green Program (GTGP) land plots if the program ends. GTGP is one of the world's largest PES programs and plays an important role in global conservation efforts. Our study was conducted in China's Wolong Nature Reserve, home to the world-famous endangered giant pandas and >4,500 farmers. We found that, in addition to conservation payment amounts and program duration, social norms at the neighborhood level had significant impacts on program re-enrollment, suggesting that social norms can be used to leverage participation to enhance the sustainability of conservation benefits from PES programs. Moreover, our results demonstrate that economic and demographic trends also have profound implications for sustainable conservation. Thus, social norms should be incorporated with economic and demographic trends for efficient conservation investments.
abstract_zh: 将社会规范与生态系统服务付费中的高效保护投资联系起来。全球范围内用于保护和恢复生态系统服务的投资持续增长。包括生态系统服务付费（PES）在内的保护投资的效率，已被发现受到生物、政治、经济、人口和社会等因素的影响，但社区层面的社会规范所产生的作用却鲜为人知。作为量化社会规范效应的初步尝试，我们研究了一系列可能的因素如何影响农户在退耕还林（Grain-to-Green Program，GTGP）地块上的保林意愿，即在该计划结束后，农户是否仍打算保持林地。退耕还林计划是世界上规模最大的生态系统服务付费计划之一，在全球保护工作中发挥着重要作用。我们的研究在中国卧龙自然保护区开展，该保护区是世界著名濒危动物大熊猫的栖息地，居住着超过 4,500 名农民。我们发现，除保护补偿金额和计划期限外，社区层面的社会规范对计划的再参与率也具有显著影响，这表明社会规范可以用于撬动参与，从而增强生态系统服务付费计划保护成果的可持续性。此外，我们的研究结果表明，经济和人口变化趋势对可持续保护也具有深远影响。因此，在高效的保护投资中，应当将社会规范与经济及人口变化趋势结合起来加以考虑。

title: Payment for environmental services: estimating demand within a tropical watershed
venue: Journal of Natural Resource Policy Research
abstract: The long-term success of payment for environmental services (PES) schemes depends on adequate demand for services and sustainable financing. We examine the viability of using locally financed payments to protect watershed services in rural eastern Costa Rica. Using dichotomous choice contingent valuation, we measure households' willingness to pay higher water bills for a local PES programme to adjust upstream land use practices to protect downstream water quality. We found that every income segment of the local population of water-users exhibited significant demand and willingness to finance the PES programme to protect local water quality.
abstract_zh: 环境服务付费：估计热带流域内的需求。环境服务付费（PES）计划能否长期成功，取决于服务需求是否充足以及融资是否可持续。我们考察了在哥斯达黎加东部农村地区利用本地融资的付费机制来保护流域服务的可行性。我们采用二分选择条件价值评估法，测量家庭为本地环境服务付费计划多支付水费的意愿，该计划旨在调整上游土地利用方式，以保护下游水质。我们发现，当地用水人口的每一个收入群体都表现出显著的需求，并愿意为该环境服务付费计划融资，以保护当地水质。

title: Ecosystem services and agriculture: Cultivating agricultural ecosystems for diverse benefits
Socioeconomic Consequences of Mercury Use and Pollution
abstract: In the past, human activities often resulted in mercury releases to the biosphere with little consideration of undesirable consequences for the health of humans and wildlife. This paper outlines the pathways through which humans and wildlife are exposed to mercury. Fish consumption is the major route of exposure to methylmercury. Humans can also receive toxic doses of mercury through inhalation of elevated concentrations of gaseous elemental mercury. We propose that any effective strategy for reducing mercury exposures requires an examination of the complete life cycle of mercury. This paper examines the life cycle of mercury from a global perspective and then identifies several approaches to measuring the benefits of reducing mercury exposure, policy options for reducing Hg emissions, possible exposure reduction mechanisms, and issues associated with mercury risk assessment and communication for different populations.
abstract_zh: 汞的使用与污染的社会经济后果。过去，人类活动常常向生物圈释放汞，却很少考虑其对人类和野生动物健康可能造成的不利后果。本文概述了人类和野生动物接触汞的途径。食用鱼类是甲基汞暴露的主要途径。人类也可能通过吸入高浓度的气态元素汞而受到有毒剂量的汞暴露。我们认为，任何有效减少汞暴露的策略都需要考察汞的完整生命周期。本文从全球视角考察了汞的生命周期，并进一步识别了若干方法，用于衡量减少汞暴露的效益、减少汞排放的政策选项、可能的暴露减少机制，以及针对不同人群的汞风险评估与风险沟通所涉及的问题。

title: Valuing Deer Hunting Services from Farm Landscapes
What does the public know about wetlands in Michigan? Using focus groups for scoping and exploratory research
Comparing Urban and Rural Perceptions of and Familiarity with the Management of Forest Ecosystems
abstract: Forests generate market (e.g., timber) and nonmarket (e.g., wildlife) values to individuals, and multiple-use forest management involves making trade-offs between different management goals. This research uses results from six focus-groups to understand how the public perceives these trade-offs and examines differences between urban and rural groups in Michigan's Central Upper Peninsula. Results reveal differences between rural, timber-dependent and urban, non-timber-dependent participants' familiarity with forest management and ecological interactions within forests. Results support the idea that rural, timber-dependent community members are very concerned about the continued provision of both market and nonmarket forest outputs. Urban, non-timber-dependent community residents have milder concerns for sustaining multiple forest outputs but expressed strong concerns for maintaining recreational opportunities for personal uses. The results do not support the hypothesis that rural/urban views lie as expected along an anthropocentric–biocentric continuum.
abstract_zh: 城乡居民对森林生态系统管理的认知与熟悉程度比较。森林为个人带来市场价值（如木材）和非市场价值（如野生动物）。多用途森林管理需要在不同的管理目标之间进行权衡。本研究利用六场焦点小组访谈的结果，了解公众如何看待这些权衡，并考察密歇根州中部上半岛城乡群体之间的差异。结果显示，依赖木材产业的农村居民与不依赖木材产业的城市居民，在对森林管理和森林内生态相互作用的熟悉程度上存在差异。研究结果支持以下观点：依赖木材产业的农村社区成员非常关注市场性和非市场性森林产出的持续供给。不依赖木材产业的城市居民对维持多种森林产出的关切程度较为温和，但对维护个人使用的休闲娱乐机会表现出强烈关切。研究结果不支持以下假设：城乡观点会如预期那样沿着人类中心主义—生态中心主义的连续谱分布。

title: Ecosystem Services from Agriculture: Looking Beyond the Usual Suspects
abstract: The concept of ecosystem services (ES) pro-vides a transformative lens for thinking about the relation between humankind and nature. The lens is especially revealing when applied to agriculture, the most widespread managed ecosystem on the planet. ES are defined as “the conditions and processes through which natu-ral ecosystems, and the species that make them up, sustain and fulfill human life ” (Daily 1997). By focusing on what ecosystems do for hu-mans, the ES concept invites analysis of what humans do to ecosystems and why they do it. Agriculture (including planted forests) conventionally supplies food, fiber, and fuel—“provisioning services ” in ES parlance (Millennium Ecosystem Assessment 2005). Farmers also help to maintain the natural “supporting ” ES that make agriculture pro-ductive, such as pollination, biological pest regulation, and soil nutrient renewal. In theory, the same managed ecosystems that provide these marketed products could produce other types of ES if suitable incentives existed. The broad class of “regulation ES ” covers climate regulation, water purity, surface water flows, groundwater levels, and waste absorption and breakdown. title: Environmental Constraints on Hydropower: An Ex-Post Benefit-Cost Analysis of Dam Relicensing in Michigan
abstract: We conduct a benefit-cost analysis of a relicensing agreement for two hydroelectric dams in Michigan. The agreement changed daily conditions from peaking to run-of-river flows. We consider three categories of costs and benefits: producer costs of adapting electricity production to the new time profile of hydroelectric output; benefits of reductions in air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions; and benefits of improved recreational fishing. The best estimates suggest that the aggregate benefits are more than twice as large as the producer costs. The conceptual and empirical methods provide a template for investigating the effects of an environmental constraint on hydroelectric dams. (JEL Q43, Q57)
